title: 潮騒のアーカイブと、空飛ぶ廃船の行方
author: 群青 リク

en.title: The Archive of the Tide and the Fate of the Flying Shipwreck
en.premise: In a city where memories are traded as physical commodities, strangers drift together, each clutching a fragment of a certain 'lost memory.' A legendary derelict ship floating in the sky holds the key to mending their fractured hearts. When these nameless memories are finally woven together, the cruel and beautiful truth hidden within the city will be unveiled.

zh.title: 潮声档案与飞行废船的去向
zh.premise: 在记忆可以作为物质买卖的城市中，一群各自持有某段『失落记忆』碎片的陌生人命运交织。而那艘漂浮在天空中的传说之废船，将成为连接他们残缺之心的钥匙。当这些不属于任何人的记忆被拼凑在一起时，隐藏在城市深处的残酷而美丽的真相，终将揭晓。
